title: Operator upgrade hang caused by webhook probe timeouts — implement safe rollforward and autofix
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Multiple customers running Private/VPC clusters reported failed operator upgrades where Helm completed but controller reconciliation stalled. Root cause analysis shows the operator's post-upgrade webhook readiness probe can hit a long-running cert-rotation/initialization path causing K8s to mark the webhook as unready. This unready webhook blocks mutating/admission calls leading to controllers holding leader locks and Helm hooks timing out. Impact: customer control plane appears healthy but reconcile loops are paused, leading to API 5xxs for control-plane operations, failed CRD migrations, and blocked customer upgrade flows. Goal: provide an emergency-safe hotfix that adds a short-circuit probe and safe rollforward path to release locks, unblock reconciliations, and provide a non-breaking, reversible patch for 1) immediate customer remediation 2) short-term rollout for all affected Private clusters and 3) follow-up improvements (probe instrumentation, canary rollout policy).
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 — Aisha Patel: Ticket opened after PagerDuty escalation from two customers in EMEA experiencing stuck upgrades. Initial slack thread: #onprem-ops. Collected cluster logs, helm history, and operator pod logs. Noted mutatingwebhook TLS handshake timeouts and controller leader lease renewal failures.

2026-03-10 11:46 — Miguel Santos: Reproduced in staging by applying upgrade job with intentional slow cert refresh. Observed webhook readiness probe failing when cert symlink update takes >30s. Leader election loop blocks on webhook-based admission call.

2026-03-10 13:05 — Miguel Santos: Hypothesis: readiness probe (which performs a self-admission check) is too heavy — uses cert rotation path that may block. Proposed short-term: change readiness probe to a lightweight HTTP health endpoint that doesn't touch certs and add a two-minute safe rollforward controller that forcibly unblocks leases when upgrade is detected. Long-term: refactor cert rotation to async background refresh and add circuit breaker for admission calls.

2026-03-11 08:30 — Design review: Lena Park: UX impact minimal; we should surface upgrade state in Console and send a customer-facing runbook link. Drafted a small Console banner copy: "Operator upgrade in progress — temporary control plane reconciliation delays possible."

2026-03-11 10:00 — Security: Rajiv Menon: Reviewed change; switching readiness probe to non-privileged endpoint is acceptable for hotfix. Requested follow-up PR to ensure the new probe cannot be used to bypass auth. Added security_review_required=false for emergency patch but requires full review pre-general release.

2026-03-11 15:22 — Miguel Santos: POC branch created: feat/hotfix/readiness-shortcircuit. Changes: 1) readiness probe endpoint /healthz/shallow that checks only basic event loop and DB connectivity; 2) rollforward controller that watches helm release annotations and will release leader leases after configurable timeout with an operator-initiated synthetic event to kick reconciliation. Unit tests added for lease release path.

2026-03-12 09:40 — QA: Naomi Chen: Ran POC in staging with a simulated slow cert rotation. Hotfix unblocked controller within 45s and allowed Helm post-upgrade hooks to finish. Observed no regressions in admission flows for existing clusters. Added e2e test scenario and load test with 50 concurrent upgrades.

2026-03-12 17:10 — Customer Success: Jordan Lee: Informed the two escalated customers that we have a hotfix and offered expedited rollout to their clusters. Both requested immediate remediation and asked for postmortem and mitigation plan. Opened support cases CS-4342 and CS-4343.

2026-03-13 07:50 — Ops: Deployed canary hotfix to 5 internal staging clusters and one small customer test cluster in APAC during low-business window. No adverse signals. Integrated enhanced metrics: webhook_probe_duration_seconds and lease_unblock_count.

2026-03-13 12:30 — Miguel Santos: Created PR #5982 with hotfix and documented rollback steps. PR includes feature flag to gate rollforward controller under config 'enableSafeRollforward'. Added automation to inject synthetic reconciliation event for leader lease release. Requesting fast-track review and merge.

2026-03-13 15:00 — Code Review: Priya Singh: Reviewed PR; requested minor changes around RBAC to ensure synthetic event creator has minimal perms. Also requested a toggle to disable rollforward per-tenant (for Dedicated customers) and explicit telemetry on when rollforward triggers.

2026-03-14 09:00 — Release: Hotfix merged to release branch. Rolling rollout plan: 1) immediate patch to affected customer clusters (on-call to coordinate), 2) progressive roll to all Private clusters over 24 hours with canary and health gates, 3) follow-up stable release after full security review and tests.
playbook: Remediation steps: 1) Deploy hotfix image tag=onprem-operator:2026.03.14-hotfix to affected clusters. 2) Ensure feature flag enableSafeRollforward=true in operator config for clusters requiring automated unblock. 3) Monitor metrics webhook_probe_duration_seconds and lease_unblock_count. 4) If customer prefers manual control, set enableSafeRollforward=false and run manual leader lease release script in runbook. 5) Post-deployment: schedule full security review and promote to stable release only after verification.
postmortem_plan: Short-term: hotfix rollout and customer remediation. Medium-term (2-4 weeks): refactor cert rotation to be asynchronous, add admission call circuit breaker, and add preflight probe that runs before helm upgrade finalization. Long-term: add canary upgrade automation and console-visible upgrade states tied to rollout policies.
